en: Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen.
it: Trova il Montanaro Cornelius nel Grizzled Den per la Montanara Gretchen.

en: Collect 8 Flintfire Shipments from the Grizzled Den for Tongus Flintfire in Kharanos.
it: Raccogli 8 Flintfire Shipments nel Grizzled Den per Tongus Flintfire a Kharanos.

en: Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.
it: Controlla come sta la Montanara Gretchen a ovest di Kharanos.

en: Seek aid from Byancie in Dolanaar for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow.
it: Chiedi aiuto a Byancie a Dolanaar per la Sentinella Eralya Leafshadow.

en: Collect 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds, an Empty Vial, and a Refreshing Spring Water for Byancie in Dolanaar.
it: Raccogli 6 Dewy Lasher Fronds, una Empty Vial e una Refreshing Spring Water per Byancie a Dolanaar.

en: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Avette Fellwood in Duskwood.
it: Consegna la Blood-Stained Letter ad Avette Fellwood a Boscovespro.

en: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
it: Entra nei siti di scavo delle Paludi Grigie e riporta della Thicket Raptor Meat.
